meta.title: Back Pain & Lumbar Rehabilitation | Cambridge Hospital
meta.description: Managing pain and improving movement, posture and daily function.

overview: Chronic and acute lower back pain, including disc prolapse, facet joint pain and sciatica, affects quality of life profoundly and is one of the leading causes of disability worldwide.

At Cambridge Hospital, our rehabilitation services offer assessment for lumbar conditions and therapy services that include manual therapy, core stabilisation, postural and movement retraining and pain management education. For patients who have undergone spinal surgery, structured inpatient and day-programme rehabilitation supports a safe and faster return to function.
